# The first updatebot follow-up removes only the explicit no-lint argument

The selected follow-up removes --no-lint from ExtendedConduit.submit while retaining moz-phab submit -s and the existing run_cmd result/error path. The immediate backout restores the prior complete file blob; accepted source later omits the flag again after separate phases. This proves the argument-vector changes, not the external tool lint defaults, successful submission or a reason for the backout. No command ran.

Scope: Updatebot moz-phab submit argument phases.
